_readme: Where wild crops and fruit trees generate (Creative Delight). Applied at world load by
kubejs/data/creativedelight/kubejs/_worldgen/wild_crops.js (creativedelight-common.toml [worldgen] wildCrops). Rejoin the
world after editing; only chunks generated afterwards change. Authored in the pack folder, copied into the Creative Delight
jar at the same path; the folder copy wins while it exists. Reference + tests: feature_writeup/crops.md section 2.8,
creative_delight.md 24. Resolved biome lists: feature_writeup/crops_by_biome.md (python3 tools/gen_crop_worldgen_table.py).
Biome traits: kubejs/generation_scripts/worldgen/biome_traits.json (shared with the pack's other biome-rule systems).
Biomes marked 'ocean' or 'cave' never match a crop rule.
crops: one entry per biome list.
where: clauses, OR'ed. A clause is traits that must all hold; '!trait' must not hold.
add / except: biome ids added after / removed after the clauses.
features: placed features added to those biomes (via the biome tag creativedelight:wild_crops/<key>).
disable_modifiers: the mods' own biome modifiers for this crop, replaced by forge:none.
remove_features: features that biome files list (vanilla patches via Terralith); removed from every overworld
biome, so 'features' must hold Creative Delight's copy (creativedelight:wild/*) instead.
step: the decoration step the features are added at (default vegetal_decoration; underground_ores for ore-like features).
label: shown in the reports.  notes: why, for the reader.
requires: a mod id the rule needs besides its features' own namespaces; the rule is skipped without it.
A rule with requires also gates its Creative Delight features (creativedelight:wild/*): the jar build moves their files
into packs/worldgen/<requires>/, a data pack loaded only with that mod. Set it on every rule whose wild/* files name a mod.
Mushrooms (brown and red colonies, inky cap, morel, caves) are in the pack's mushroom_spawns.json.

cabbage.label: Cabbage
cabbage.notes: Pack feature: FD's own only tests for sand below; this one also takes dirt/grass (cliff tops).

turnip.label: Turnip
turnip.notes: Wherever sea beets grow; the port takes sand or dirt below, as the pack sea beet feature does. 1 in 30 chunks.

broccoli.label: Broccoli
broccoli.notes: Veggies Delight backport: the port ships the feature with its rarity and no biome modifier. 1 in 240 chunks, half the carrot and onion rate.

oats.label: Oats
oats.notes: Vintage Delight backport: the port ships the feature and no biome modifier. Vintage's own filter was overworld 0.4 to 0.9 temperature (the temperate band, swamps included); the pack adds the cold grassy biomes (owner, 2026-10-23). Grows on any dirt soil.

peanuts.label: Peanuts
peanuts.notes: Vintage's filter was the same as oats; the pack moves them to the hot dry grassy biomes (owner, 2026-10-23). Any dirt soil.

cucumbers.label: Cucumbers
cucumbers.notes: Vintage's filter was #forge:is_wet (swamps, jungles, mangroves); the pack adds the cold and temperate grassy biomes (owner, 2026-10-23). The port's patch takes any dirt soil (sand dropped).

pumpkin.label: Pumpkin
pumpkin.notes: No orchard biome exists in the pack; 'autumn' = Terralith Skylands Autumn, which also keeps its own pumpkin patch.

cocoa.label: Cocoa
cocoa.notes: Cocoa only comes on vanilla-style jungle trees. The excepted biomes already grow them; the rest get a jungle tree in 1 chunk of 3.

raspberry.label: Raspberry
raspberry.notes: Hearth and Harvest 1.4.1's patch (Farmer's Delight wild crop: ripe bushes on dirt with grass and coarse dirt, 1 in 62 chunks), as Creative Delight's copy. 1.4.1 placed it in every overworld biome of temperature 0.4 to 0.9; here the temperate grassy biomes, plus the blueberry biomes (cold grassy snowy; owner 2026-11-02, farming/wild-crops #7).

cantaloupe.label: Mini Cantaloupe
cantaloupe.notes: Cantaloupe merge (item_merges.md 2.10): Delightful's cantaloupe is the Mini Cantaloupe and grows where the Cantaloupe (hamimelon) does, on the same soils (pack feature, copy of wild/hamimelon). Was warm dry grassy, Delightful's patch.

giant_bell_pepper.label: Giant Bell Peppers
giant_bell_pepper.notes: Rustic Delight 1.7.0 (Creative Delight): red, yellow and green giant peppers, 1 in 64 chunks (owner 2026-10-25: fairly rare); the port drops upstream's own biome modifier. Owner 2026-10-25: hot dry grassy, like the wild crops there.

coffee.label: Coffee (Rustic Delight)
coffee.notes: farmersrespite:coffee_bush is the Basalt Deltas spawn of Farmer's Respite's coffee; switched off.

tea.label: Tea
tea.notes: Wet and misty ground: every swamp and jungle, the sakura biomes, plus the damp forests (downfall 0.8 or cloud cover). The bush needs #minecraft:dirt, which holds mud.

flax.label: Flax (off)
flax.notes: Wild flax is off: Supplementaries' config has it disabled and its modifier is forge:none here too, so flipping the config does not bring it back.

mint.label: Mint
mint.notes: The mint pond needs a flat grass spot, so rocky and snowy peaks are left out by 'grassy'.

banana.label: Banana
banana.notes: Dense jungles keep Neapolitan's common rate; the beach spawn (rare) is switched off.

cranberry.label: Cranberry
cranberry.notes: Cold wet = Caldera, Cloud Forest, Ice Marsh, Siberian Taiga, Yellowstone (the cold biomes with 'wet').

pineapple.label: Pineapple
pineapple.notes: Fruits Delight's feature needs sand below; outside beaches it only takes where the coast has sand.

hamimelon.label: Cantaloupe
hamimelon.notes: Pack feature: Fruits Delight's own needs plain sand; this one takes sand, red sand and terracotta.

apple.label: Apple (tree)
apple.notes: Vinery apple tree. Oak/dark oak leaves no longer drop apples (loot/08_leaf_apples.js).

grape.label: Grapes (red and white bushes)
grape.notes: Vinery's rate (1 chunk in 22 each). Vinery's own lists were vanilla tags only (forests, rivers, mountains, plains).

grape_jungle.label: Grapes (jungle vines)
grape_jungle.notes: Vines hang off tree trunks and walls, so only tree-covered warm wet biomes (1 chunk in 10 each, Vinery's rate).

rubber.label: Rubber tree
rubber.notes: Myrtrees adds its tree from Java (Architectury biome modification, id minecraft:rubber_tree_placement; 1% of chunks x 5 trees, any forest/taiga/jungle). Removed everywhere, pack copy in 1 chunk of 4 in jungles.

sea_grape.label: Sea Grape
sea_grape.notes: Oceanic Delight (Creative Delight member); the sea floor of the mod's three warm oceans. Pack feature wild/sea_grape: the newer Oceanic jar's patch (64 tries, spread 6; was 32 / 5), 1 in 30 chunks as the mod's (starting density, farming/wild-crops #6); the mod's own modifier off. 'add' because ocean biomes never match a where clause.

rooted_dirt.label: Rooted Dirt and Truffle Dirt (truffle ground)
rooted_dirt.notes: Fungi Delight's blob (size 20, turns dirt near the surface into rooted dirt), 1 in 3 chunks, then its truffle ore (size 6, replaces rooted dirt only): every chunk, 5 tries near the surface, so it only lands where a blob is. One rule, so one modifier adds both in this order and the blob is always placed first (two rules gave no truffle dirt at all, scratch r1102 SQ-FGD-14; creativedelight members #42). Fungi's own biomes were every taiga and the dark forest; the pack keeps the dark forest and the cold forests and adds birch forests (owner 2026-11-02; fungi_delight.md 5.1.3). The port ships no biome modifier.

end_amberveil.label: Amberveils (End)
end_amberveil.notes: Ender's Delight 1.1.4's patch (10 tries, spread 3), 1 in 10 chunks, on end stone only. Rebuilt in the enders_additions member; 1.1.4's biome modifiers are not shipped. The four vanilla End land biomes (1.1.4's list) plus Nullscape's three land biomes.

end_chorusflame.label: Chorusflame (End)
end_chorusflame.notes: 1.1.4's patch, ages 0 to 2 mixed, 1 in 15 chunks, on end stone only. The four vanilla End land biomes (1.1.4's list) plus Nullscape's three land biomes.

end_saffron.label: Ethereal Saffron (End)
end_saffron.notes: 1.1.4's patch (4 tries, spread 1), 1 in 25 chunks, on end stone only. The four vanilla End land biomes (1.1.4's list) plus Nullscape's three land biomes.

end_voidpepper.label: Void Pepper Sprout (End)
end_voidpepper.notes: 1.1.4's patch, spreading sprouts on the ground, 1 in 15 chunks, on end stone only; they spread and fruit by random tick. The four vanilla End land biomes (1.1.4's list) plus Nullscape's three land biomes.

chorus_succulent.label: Chorus Succulent (End)
chorus_succulent.notes: End's Delight 2.1 places it from Java (its placed feature ends_delight:chorus_succulent: 1 in 8 chunks, 20 tries, 1 to 3 per block) in the End Highlands only; same feature and biome here, its modifier off (ends_delight.md 3.1, mod-additions #15: kept).
